description: This file declares the TestService class within the rialto::servermanager namespace. The class provides an interface for managing server state, including starting, stopping, and configuring server sessions, as well as retrieving server and application information. It includes dependencies on server management, logging, and state observation components, and manages synchronization primitives for thread safety.

classes.name: TestService
classes.description: A class that manages server sessions and state, providing methods to run, shutdown, set state, get state, retrieve app info, and set log levels.

methods.name: TestService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a server configuration.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the session server state for a given application.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current session server state for a given application.

methods.name: getAppInfo
methods.description: Returns information about a specific application.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Configures logging levels for the service.
